title: Counting Things to 10
short: Count up to 10 things in rows, circles or a jumble.
trouble: In a jumble, children lose track of which ones they counted.

blocks.html: Let’s count bigger groups, up to 10. Things can be in a row, in a circle or all mixed up. Touch each one, and keep track of which ones you counted!

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: These ladybugs are all mixed up. Tap each one as you count.

blocks.html: In a jumble, touch each one and keep track. Tapped ones are done.

For the grown-up: For a jumble, show your child how to push each counted thing to one side. A row, a circle and a pile of the same things all give the same count. Try it with 8 pebbles. A few problems on the screen is plenty. The real practice is with things you can touch.

items: Try it at home: Count 10 pebbles or leaves on a walk.
Count toy cars in a circle, then in a line.
Count grapes cut in half on a plate.

sources.name: Head Start Early Learning Outcomes Framework (ELOF), Mathematics Development, preschool goals P-MATH 1 to 10
